content: The follower handles also use their usernames to show support to a movement or person and revert back to their original username later. Out of the $79,991$ username changes, $1,711$ users of set ${S}$ went back and forth to the same name which included adding of Election related keywords. Examples of few such cases in our dataset are shown in Table TABREF16.
